args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Error rate was 0.18 and service was unhealthy. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions. Rollback completed successfully.

trace.final:

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status confirms v2.3.0 is deployed in all regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002.
